text:
Maya Patel: Quick PSA — I hit a console->deployment mismatch with route YAML validation.
Maya Patel: Console allowed a routing rule that runtime rejected at startup.
Sanjay Rao: ugh, reproduction steps?
Maya Patel: repro below. I saved this in Console, it passed preflight, but Dedicated runtime errors on model routing.
Maya Patel: ```yaml
routes:
  - match:
      headers:
        X-Feature: beta
      path: /api/v1/*
    target: model-alpha
    defaults:
      timeout: 30
      priority: 10
``` 
Eli G.: What's the error from runtime?
Maya Patel: runtime logs: "invalid header matcher: anchor 'X-Feature' unexpected" — suggests runtime expects headers as list of {name,value} not mapping.
Courtney Lee: The schema in console is ajv-based, we accept both mapping and list via a transform. Maybe transform only happens client-side.
CI Bot: lint-checker found no schema violations (rules:v2) — result: pass
Sanjay Rao: So console accepts mapping, sends final YAML to API as-is, and server-side validator is stricter. We need a canonicalizer in the backend or stricter console validator.
Alex M.: Could we add a preflight server-side schema check in the control plane before saving? That'd catch mismatches.
Ravi Singh: Agree. Also we should avoid changing the canonical wire format; pick one (list of header objects) and make console convert before save.
Maya Patel: Minimal fix proposal: console transforms header maps into array of objects and include schemaVersion in payload. I'll open a PR.
Eli G.: Also add a short unit test in routing-config-tests that sends both formats and ensures server accepts canonicalized payload.
Courtney Lee: Can you include an example in the UX tooltip so users don't paste maps and get surprised? Small copy: "For headers, use list format or we'll convert for you." :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/842
CI Bot: deploy-check queued for PR 842
Sanjay Rao: Thanks — capturing as action: (1) console transform+schemaVersion, (2) control-plane preflight validation, (3) routing-config-test added.
Maya Patel: I'll shepherd. Thanks all :raised_hands:
